question: Which AutoClip workflows are documented by official public pages, and which comparisons with Ashvane remain untested?
reader: Official web reads; requested local Qwen fetch tools unavailable in this session

claims.statement: AutoClip advertises linked/file video intake and monitored new uploads or livestream VODs; rolling live-edge capture is not established by this page.
The current pricing page lists monthly Starter 19.99 USD/200 credits, Pro 39.99/500 and Scale 79.99/1200, with highlight billing for streams.
The AI-clipping page advertises transcript-first selection, multimodal verification and tight/extended variants; quality and speed were not benchmarked here.
The dedicated posting page documents TikTok, Instagram and YouTube; the cross-posting article instead lists nine destinations.
The monitoring guide itself contains both nine-destination and 13-plus-destination wording.
Homepage plan FAQ allowance/watermark wording conflicts with the current pricing page.
The privacy policy discloses external AI/media processing and tokens held by backend or publishing partners.

The terms do not guarantee AI accuracy or commercial results; connected-account terms describe promotional/automated authority while connected, including after subscription ends. Actual account consent was not tested.
AutoClip is more accurate, faster or more profitable than Ashvane on comparable sources.
